entities.summary: The Podilskyi Bridge Crossing, formerly known as Podilsko-Voskresenskyi Bridge, is a combined road-rail bridge over the Dnipro River under construction in Kyiv, Ukraine. It is a focal point of construction of the Podilsko-Vyhurivska Line of the Kyiv Metro. A part of the bridge was opened with restrictions on 1 December 2023, and a year later its connection to Troieshchyna was fully opened.
